author: Damodar Adhikari
review_text: The customer care experience has been quite terrible; despite my attempts to reset my forgotten password, they did not assist. After requesting account deletion, they deleted it, but when I opened a new account, it was immediately blocked. Despite several appeals over the previous month, totaling over 50 times, I requested to unblock my account, but nothing was done, leaving me terribly dissatisfied and heartbroken. 😢.
